tasks.title: Conversation #105
tasks.transcript:
Man: Have you decided where to hold the conference next month?
Woman: Yes, we're going to host it at the Grand Hotel downtown. It has excellent facilities.
Man: That sounds perfect. Do they offer catering services?
Woman: Yes, they do. We can choose from a wide variety of options, everything from snacks to full meals, but only if we pay for at least 50 people.
Man: Okay, that's good to know.

questions.stem: Where will the conference be held?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：会议将在哪里举行？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes, we‘re going to host it at the Grand Hotel downtown. 选项分析： A. At a community center 在社区中心。对话中未提及社区中心，所以A选项错误。 B. At a hotel 在酒店。女士明确说在“Grand Hotel”（格兰德酒店）举办，所以B选项正确。 C. In an office 在办公室里。对话中未提及办公室，所以C选项错误。 D. At a restaurant 在餐厅。对话中未提及餐厅，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman say about catering services?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：关于餐饮服务，女士说了什么？ 定位原文：Woman: We can choose from a wide variety of options ... but only if we pay for at least 50 people. 选项分析： A. They are too expensive. 它们太贵了。对话中未提及价格高低，所以A选项错误。 B. They require a minimum purchase. 它们有最低消费要求。女士明确说只有至少支付50人的费用才能选择餐饮，这属于最低人数/消费要求，所以B选项正确。 C. They are unavailable. 它们无法提供。对话中女士说可以选择餐饮，说明服务是提供的，所以C选项错误。 D. They provide only snacks. 它们只提供小吃。女士说可以选择从零食到正餐的各种选项，所以D选项错误。
